events.title: Summer Open House
events.description: Come meet our teachers, explore our classrooms, and learn about our Montessori philosophy. All families welcome — no RSVP required.

events.title: Parent Information Night
events.description: An evening session for prospective families to learn about our programs, curriculum, and enrollment process.

events.title: Garden Planting Day
events.description: Families and children are invited to join us for a morning of planting, soil, and sunshine in our school garden.

events.title: Fall Enrollment Opens
events.description: Fall 2026 enrollment opens for new and returning families. Schedule a tour to learn more before spots fill.

events.title: Music & Movement Morning
events.description: A fun, family-friendly morning of singing, dancing, and musical exploration. Open to all ages — bring the whole family!

events.title: End-of-Summer Celebration
events.description: Celebrate our summer families and welcome our new fall families with food, art displays, and community time.
